## README.md
# Brazilian Secondary Forest Dynamics (1986–2024)

Annual maps of increment, extent, age, and loss of secondary forests in Brazil, derived from MapBiomas Collection 10.1 land-use and land-cover data using Google Earth Engine. The **Forest Formation** and **Flooded Forest** classes are included.

## Products

| Product | Description | Period |
|:---|:---|:---:|
| **Age** | Years of continuous secondary forest since last disturbance | 1986–2024 |
| **Extent** | Binary presence/absence of secondary forest | 1986–2024 |
| **Increment** | New secondary forest pixels per year | 1986–2024 |
| **Loss** | Secondary forest pixels cleared per year | 1987–2024 |

## Technical Specifications

| Parameter | Value |
|:---|:---:|
| Spatial resolution | 30 m |
| CRS | EPSG:4326 (WGS84) |
| Format | Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF (COG) |
| Input data | MapBiomas Collection 10.1 |
| Forest classes | Forest Formation, Flooded Forest |
| Version | v8.1 |

## GEE Assets

Multi-band assets (one band per year, named `classification_YYYY`) are publicly available:

```javascript
var age       = ee.Image('users/ybyrabr/public/secondary_forest_age_collection10_1_v8_1');
var extent    = ee.Image('users/ybyrabr/public/secondary_forest_extent_collection10_1_v8_1');
var increment = ee.Image('users/ybyrabr/public/secondary_forest_increment_collection10_1_v8_1');
var loss      = ee.Image('users/ybyrabr/public/secondary_forest_loss_collection10_1_v8_1');
```
